Kr4I6Iy2m7ZWnQCN6LzP-g.zh: 拉脫維亞今年截至9/1累計報告17例確定病例,所有病患均住院接受治療。此病例數高於去(2025)年11例,更為過去10年(2015至2024年)總數7例之2.4倍。病例分布於全國5個地區,並以中南部澤姆加爾 (Zemgale)及里加(Riga)為多,患者以中年男性為主(71%)。專家推測洪災頻繁,衍生囓齒類動物及蚊蜱病媒增加 ,導致⺠眾進行戶外活動時 ,暴露風險增加。未經治療個案致死率可達15%,當局呼籲⺠眾加強個人防護。
Kr4I6Iy2m7ZWnQCN6LzP-g.en: Latvia has reported 17 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 1 September, and all patients were hospitalised for treatment. This is higher than the 11 cases for all of last year (2025), and 2.4 times the total of 7 cases over the past decade (2015–2024). Cases are distributed across five regions of the country, mainly Zemgale in the centre-south and Riga, and patients are mainly middle-aged men (71%). Experts suspect that frequent flooding has increased rodents and mosquito and tick vectors, raising exposure risk for people engaged in outdoor activities. The case fatality rate for untreated cases can reach 15%, and authorities urge people to strengthen personal protection.

f9EYEdSju18d9yx1fovYBQ.zh: 拉脫維亞疫情升高,9月單月新增680例病例,且發病率仍持續上升,今年迄今累計報告2,517例,其中1例死亡;該國去年僅報告112例。 韓國11/12報告今年首例死亡病例,為未滿2個月嬰兒,於接種首劑疫苗前即感染;該國今年疫情嚴峻,累計報告30,332例疑病例,遠高於新冠疫情前規模(單年千例以下),病例分布於全國,多發生於7至19歲青少年,當局呼籲高風險族群按時接種疫苗。
f9EYEdSju18d9yx1fovYBQ.en:
Latvia's outbreak is rising. In September alone, 680 new cases were reported, and incidence continues to climb. This year, 2,517 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death; the country reported only 112 cases last year.

South Korea reported its first death this year on 12 November, in an infant under 2 months old who was infected before receiving the first dose of vaccine. The outbreak in the country this year is severe, with 30,332 suspected cases cumulatively reported, far above the pre-COVID-19 level of fewer than 1,000 cases per year. Cases are distributed nationwide, mostly among adolescents aged 7 to 19. Authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated on schedule.
